टंक् {c10c} U. (टंकयति-ते, टंकित)
1 To
bind, tie, fasten.
--2 To cover. --WITH
उद् {1} to scrape, scratch. {2} to bore
out, pierce through.

टंकः, --कं [टंक्-घञ् अच् वा]
1 A hatchet,
an axe; a stone-cutter's chisel;
टंकैर्मनः शिलगुहेव विदार्यमाणा

.
--2 A sword.
--3 The sheath
of a sword.
--4 A peak shaped like
the edge of a hatchet; the slope or
declivity of a hill;

.
--5
Anger.
--6 Pride.
--7 The leg.
--8 A
chasm, cleft.
--9 The wood-apple tree.
--10 Borax.
--11 A weight of silver
equal to four Māṣas.
--12 The
fruit of the wood-apple (n.).
--13 A
stamped coin.
--14 A spade, hoe.
--का The leg.
